description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Nmtokens` responsible for validating and processing NMTOKEN attributes within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for validation, token splitting, and token filtering, tailored to handle space-separated token strings.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Nmtokens
classes.description: Validator class for NMTOKEN attributes, providing methods to validate and process space-separated token strings according to HTML attribute specifications.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input string as NMTOKENS, trimming it, splitting into tokens, filtering tokens, and returning a space-joined string of valid tokens or false if invalid.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a space-separated string into individual tokens using a regex pattern tailored for NMTOKEN syntax.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Provides a hook for filtering tokens based on specific criteria; currently returns tokens unchanged.
